evidence.supporting_text: This session is organized in three sections: (1) the chairs will introduce the topic and participants (~10 min); (2) participants will have seven minutes to share their work; (3) our discussants Jean Ryoo, a learning scientist and computing education researcher that has advocated for equity and inquiry-oriented computing, and Ole Sejer Iversen, a child-computer interaction and activity theory researcher that proposed the term deconstruction, will synthesize and reflect on findings (10 min), followed by a Q&A with the audience and presenters (~15 min).
